title: Seven-continent teaching region mask
encoding: base64 little-endian uint16 run length followed by uint8 region code; south-to-north rows
license: Natural Earth data are public domain; derived mask is provided on the same basis.
method: Rasterize Natural Earth 1:50m physical continent/island/island-group/isthmus regions, intersect with 1:50m land, reconcile adjacent land-only subpixel coastline gaps. No administrative country boundaries used.
notes: Geographical teaching regions, not tectonic plates, political boundaries or survey data.
Europe and Asia use the Natural Earth physical geography partition, separating European Russia from Siberia and European Thrace from Anatolia.
Oceania includes Australia, New Zealand, New Guinea, Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia, including Hawaii. Pacific geometry wraps the date line.
Greenland is grouped with North America. Antarctica includes the south-pole cap.
Simplification and the 2048x1024 mask omit some small islands and subpolar islands; coastlines are approximate at this display scale.
